description: The top 10 best-measured UseTested reviews in a category (inference|data|search|media|infrastructure), ranked by verdict tier + measured reliability — evidence depth (≥20 settled calls), composite score (0.4 reliability + 0.3 quality + 0.3 value), liveness, latency. AVOID services are never included, and there is no paging: this is a best-of list, not the whole catalogue. Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client.
